author: Ogrey
body:
₪ Hello, and welcome to the Map District! ₪
« 1 » This thread will contain updates of which maps get denied, accepted and put into rotations.
« 2 » Any question regarding your map should be asked here, not via Skype. We'd rather keep Skype as a communication device used to request aid from us to help in matters such as YML making, how to properly make a Map Release topic, and that sort of stuff.
« 3 » To avoid Forum Spam, Accepted and Denied maps would appear on this topic, rather than a post in your topic saying whether your map has been Accepted or Denied, however, feedback given by Users and Map Developers should still be given in your map topic, as usual.
« 4 » Map Review system. Your map now will be either Accepted or Denied. In case of denial, the map author will be free to update/change the map, and the updates would be announced in the same topic as the previous version of it (That means no new topics of the same map should be made). In case of acceptance, the accepted map, along with the rest of maps, would be tested and then examined carefully by Map Developers to decide if it should be added to rotations or not.

  • ₪ Map Waves ₪ Maps that get added to rotations should be announced here.

₪ MAP WAVE 4 ₪
